proof_body:
by
  intro f s c hs hd hlim
  have ho : (fun z => f z - f c) =o[nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ] fun z => (z - c)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff_tendsto']
    · have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun z => (z - c) * f c) (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds 0) := by
        have : Filter.Tendsto (fun z => (z - c) * f c) (nhds c) (nhds ((c - c) * f c)) := by
          apply Continuous.tendsto
          fun_prop
        simpa using this.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      have h2 := hlim.sub h1
      simp only [sub_zero] at h2
      refine h2.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz
      have : z - c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
      change (z - c) * f z - (z - c) * f c = (f z - f c) / (z - c)⁻¹
      field_simp
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz h
      have : z - c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
      exact absurd h (inv_ne_zero this)
  refine ⟨_, Complex.differentiableOn_update_limUnder_of_isLittleO hs hd ho, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  exact Function.update_of_ne hz.2 _ _
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (s : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ), s ∈ nhds c → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (s \ {c}) → Filter.Tendsto (fun z => (z - c) * f z) (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds 0) → ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g s ∧ ∀ z ∈ s \ {c}, g z = f z
